matchups.tips: | Idk wtf they did to him but all the sudden he is rly broken and your biggest counter! If you want to NOT take an L then ban him until they nerf him again.

| Any champ that can out gank/pressure you like Ramus, Nunu, Warwick, and Nocturne will push their team ahead of yours. Your mobility is what makes you a threat, and as your Q cooldown goes down your mobility around the map goes up. Because of this, you out-pressure a lot of junglers through your presence and skirmishing ability. Nocturne out skirmishes you a lot and out pressures you post 6 so I ban him (voli bear now cuz he is just broken). You can still skirmish if they are dumb, but otherwise, be careful and ping your team for ganks from them.

| Black shield makes you useless, and if she hits her root you will hate your life. If you want to fight her try to flash over her bind and land your Q before she shields herself. Sometimes. You can ban her but I deal with her ok lately. (UPDATE: People who play her usually suck at the game so who cares, if they don't though then it sucks lol)

| Junglers like Kha?ix, Amumu, and Trundle out skirmish you, and abuse your Q by canceling it or abusing the way it engages to their advantage. This sucks and you will have to give things sometimes because of it. You can play around it, however, just know how the enemy works and you will be fine. Zac will also just ping his team and you will die to chain cc in the skirmish.
| Olaf, Kayn, and Master Yi. You can't ult them unless their abilities are down. You still hurt him though, so unless your team feeds them you will be ok.

| Any jungler who is predictable like Kindred or Shyvana is not too bad to deal with as a highly mobile, snowballing skirmisher. You know she wants drags/your marked camp, so just bait or take them. Work with your team too. Vision is key in these matchups, and often the support gap will decide them if the players are proactive.

| You can dash through the wall of his ult, and dodge his knock-up. or just ult through his stuff. This vi build allows you to fight tanks well, as long as they don't cheese you, or they are really ahead. | Anyone you can interrupt is also ideal for you.

| He does not counter you exactly, I am just sick of seeing him so much. He has always been strong. I would still ban Nocturne (VoliBear) over him but just know you might have a bad time as they like to invade.
